cases.raw_symptoms: A 55-year-old man had rheumatic fever with a temperature of 102°F, accompanied by pain and swelling of the joints and pain in the muscles attached to the affected joints, which were aggravated by touch and motion. He experienced great thirst, constipation, dryness and a constricted feeling in the throat, with throat pain extending to the ears. His urine was scanty, hot, and yellow in color. He also suffered from great weakness, violent headache, chill, and shivering of the body.

physical.symptom: Arthritis with swelling and pain in joints and attached muscles
Pharyngitis with constriction and pain radiating to ears

concomitants: Throat pain radiating to ears during rheumatic flare
Scanty urine with systemic inflammatory state
categorised.clinical_summary: A 55-year-old male presenting with acute rheumatic fever characterized by intense inflammatory joint pain, systemic febrile state with marked thirst, and associated mucous membrane dryness and constipation.

cases.clinical_notes: The essence is a state of 'dry, inflammatory stasis.' The patient is locked in a cycle of painful immobility where any movement exacerbates the pathology, mirrored by a systemic internal dryness (thirst, constipation, scanty urine) that demands a remedy capable of acting on serous membranes to restore fluid balance and reduce inflammation.
